title: Does it work on my TV?
intro: If your TV runs Android TV or Google TV, version 8 or newer, yes. Your model does not need to be on the list.

full.name: Home screen
full.summary: Polaris TV becomes the TV's Home screen, blocks ads and trackers on the TV, and installs from the desktop app.
full.rule: Settings > About says Android TV or Google TV, version 8 or newer.

app.name: App
app.summary: Polaris TV opens as an app and the TV keeps its own Home screen. Fire TV also gets the cleanup.
app.rule: Fire TV on Fire OS 6 or newer. Apps for LG and Samsung are coming.

network.name: Network only
network.summary: No app. With your router using the Network filter for DNS, ads and trackers are blocked for every TV at home. The TV's privacy switches do the rest.
network.rule: Roku, Vizio, VIDAA, and for now LG and Samsung.

model.upstream-community: Tested by its owner with the upstream launcher, not yet with Polaris TV ({date})

quirks.tcl-autostart: TCL sets can stop a launcher from starting on its own. The desktop app allows it during the install.
quirks.google-pairing: Chromecast with Google TV and Google TV Streamer need Wireless debugging with a pairing code, and it closes again after a restart.
quirks.tcl-private-dns-prime: On a TCL 75QM751G, Prime Video did not play with Private DNS on. Block on the router instead if it happens to you.
quirks.fire-home-amazon: Amazon keeps the Home button: Polaris TV opens as an app.
quirks.samsung-2023-signing: Sets from 2023 on need a Samsung account certificate to install apps from a computer.
quirks.samsung-dev-refused: This set refused developer installs altogether.
quirks.huawei-refusal: Making it the Home screen left a set like this unable to start. Install Polaris TV as an app and leave Home alone.
quirks.android-check: Listed as plain Android. Polaris TV installs only where the TV reports Android TV; the desktop app checks first, so trying is safe.
quirks.android-too-old: Older than Polaris TV supports (Android 8, Fire OS 6).
quirks.app-coming: The Polaris TV app for this system is coming. Until then, block ads through the Network filter.

missing.title: Not on the list?
missing.intro: Open Settings > About on the TV (Device Preferences > About on some sets). What does it say?

privacy.read: Menu paths read on {date}. They change with firmware, so yours may differ.

steps.samsung-ads: Interest-Based Advertisements, Customization Service, Improve personalized ads, Get news and special offers: off. Do not track: on. Reset PSID
steps.lg-agreements: Viewing information, Voice information, Interest-based & Cross-device advertising, Marketing Communications, Who.Where.What?: off
steps.vizio-viewing: Viewing Data: off. Walmart link: off
steps.vidaa-viewing: ACR, Personalized Ads, Content Recommendation: off
steps.google-ads: Delete advertising ID, or Opt out of Ads Personalization: on
steps.fire-data: Device Usage Data, Collect App Usage Data, Interest-based Ads: off. Over-the-air Viewing Data (Fire TV sets): off

gallery.title: Themes and add-ons
gallery.intro: Choose them on the TV in Settings, Themes & add-ons. Nothing to type on a computer.
